meta.title: Benchmark spot prices & crack spread (EIA daily)
meta.description: Daily spot prices for WTI Cushing, Brent, New York Harbor gasoline and diesel, and Henry Hub natural gas, from the U.S. EIA (public domain, api.eia.gov), with a 3-2-1 crack spread computed on the spot basis. EIA discontinued publication of NYMEX futures prices in April 2024; these spot series are the public-domain record of the price deck.
sources: U.S. EIA spot price series (api.eia.gov v2)
meta.cadence: daily (EIA publication lags the trading day)

series.label: WTI crude oil spot, Cushing OK
Conventional gasoline spot, New York Harbor
Ultra-low-sulphur diesel spot, New York Harbor
3-2-1 crack spread, spot basis (2×gasoline + 1×diesel − 3×WTI, per barrel)
